messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: reduce to a min-max semialgebraic optimization and certify via sum-of-squares

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is a (1,4)-balanced strut configuration with four points at the corners, eight points arranged as antipodal pairs on the midpoints of the four edges with coordinate perturbations (±ε, ±ε), and one point at the center (1/2,1/2), where ε is the largest root of the degree-6 polynomial 2ε⁶ − 24ε⁵ + 96ε⁴ − 192ε³ + 192ε² − 96ε + 16 = 0, yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/24. This configuration is certified optimal by a degree-6 sum-of-squares relaxation of the min-max semialgebraic optimization problem min_{(x,y)∈[0,1]^{26}} max_{i<j<k} |Δ(p_i,p_j,p_k)|, where the SOS certificate multiplies the ordering constraints and minimum-area constraints by nonnegative polynomials to establish the matching upper bound."}
